decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana and play powerful colorless spells like Karn Liberated and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent with big threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. Additionally, it utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to find the necessary Tron lands quickly for a consistent game plan.

The core idea of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing a combination of powerful control cards like Supreme Verdict, Force of Negation, Counterspell, Teferi, Time Raveler, and The One Ring. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Leyline Binding and Solitude while maintaining card advantage and flexibility with Preordain, Prismatic Ending, and Chalice of the Void. The mana base is designed to support a wide range of colors to ensure consistency in casting spells and maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the opponent's board and hand while looking to establish a dominant late-game presence with powerful threats like The One Ring and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The inclusion of cards like Lórien Revealed and Subtlety provide additional control options and disruption for the opponent. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's spells and ensure consistency in casting its powerful threats.

The main concept of this UB Mill deck is to use cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity to fill up the opponent's graveyard quickly, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Archive Trap and Surgical Extraction. Once the opponent's library is depleted, cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter can finish the job by forcing them to exile cards from their library. By utilizing a combination of mill effects and disruption, this deck aims to win by emptying the opponent's library as quickly as possible.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset. It also utilizes powerful cards like Solitude and Omnath to stabilize the board and generate card advantage. The inclusion of The One Ring as a win condition provides a unique and versatile way to close out games. The mana base is carefully crafted to provide consistent access to all colors while minimizing potential drawbacks. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game by utilizing artifacts and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on generating Thopter tokens using Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek, while also using Urza, Lord High Artificer to create mana advantage. Urza's Saga is a key card in the deck that helps to tutor for important artifacts like Relic of Progenitus or Shadowspear. The inclusion of Esper Sentinel also helps to apply pressure on the opponent while drawing cards. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through its strong artifact synergy.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, card draw, and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue opponents. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through countering spells, removing threats, and sustaining card advantage. The key strategy is to establish a dominant board presence with powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred, while using The One Ring to further enhance their abilities and solidify control over the game. Overall, the deck's key concept is to maintain control and outlast opponents through efficient resource management and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence using counters and +1/+1 bonuses from cards like Hardened Scales, Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, and The Ozolith. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista while controlling the board with cards like Arcbound Ravager and Inkmoth Nexus. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration and card selection with cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga to maintain consistency and tempo. Overall, the strategy is to build a strong board presence quickly and efficiently to outpace the opponent.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free while putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Subtlety, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a speedy and unpredictable offense. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Leyline Binding helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining tempo. Overall, the deck's strategy is to cascade into threats while controlling the board and pushing through for a fast victory.

This deck focuses on dealing direct damage to the opponent as quickly as possible, utilizing efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of damage, preventing them from stabilizing or mounting a defense. The deck is streamlined for maximum efficiency, with low-curve spells and creatures to ensure a fast and consistent pace of damage output. The goal is to end the game swiftly before the opponent can mount a comeback.

This deck focuses on control, utilizing counterspells and removal spells like Fatal Push to keep the opponent's threats at bay. It aims to maintain card advantage and flexibility with cards like Opt and Snapcaster Mage. The key win condition is the use of The One Ring, a powerful artifact that provides various abilities and bonuses. Other important cards include Archmage's Charm and Force of Negation for additional control, as well as Murktide Regent for a big threat and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for board control. The deck's mana base is designed to support its control strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, backed up by strong removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and flexibility in game strategies. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds a powerful late-game threat, while Orcish Bowmasters provide consistent damage output. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By combining powerful cards like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Wrenn and Six with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage rapidly. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides extra value by tutoring for key artifacts like Mishra's Research Desk and Shadowspear. Overall, the deck's aggressive gameplay style seeks to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on control through a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Wrenn and Six, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The goal is to control the board and dictate the pace of the game until you can establish a strong board presence with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolor requirements, while Leyline Binding and Delighted Halfling provide additional protection and utility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient control and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on gaining life through Martyr of Sands and Abiding Grace while controlling the board with Skyclave Apparition and Supreme Verdict. It also utilizes Emeria, the Sky Ruin to recur creatures and generate card advantage. Ranger-Captain of Eos helps search for key pieces, and Teferi, Time Raveler disrupts opponents' strategies. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by gaining incremental advantages through lifegain and board control, eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats like Solitude and Serra Paragon. The sideboard includes additional protection and disruption options to adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through your deck quickly with cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, while also cascading into Living End with cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent. By filling your graveyard with creatures, you can then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming your opponent with a massive board presence. Additionally, cards like Force of Negation provide protection and disruption, while Curator of Mysteries provides card advantage and selection. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Karn, the Great Creator, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Solitude. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and triomes to ensure smooth color fixing. The deck also utilizes Wrenn and Six for additional value and card advantage. The main win condition lies in playing Omnath, Locus of Creation and using Leyline Binding to lock down opponent's threats. The deck also includes card draw and removal options to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent.
